scope: Offscreen native SubViewport exact RGBA and alternating actual callback CPU submission. Each pair has fresh private presenters and independently funded detached courts, while shared catalog/font/texture/process and OS caches can be warm. Candidate uses actual per-entry visual arrival API; concrete pre-T6 reference retains T5 funded staging. Preparation is consecutive logical pumps, not measured frame scheduling. Timers exclude configure, authority comparisons, image readback and checks. Embedded existing stage timers are enabled equally. No full Bootstrap integration, foreground, GPU upload, physical frame, total arrival-wall-time or fixed millisecond guarantee.
limitations: Six measured pairs per process/case, twelve combined. Nearest-rank p95 equals the maximum at both sample sizes; maxima are reported without a stable-tail or confidence-interval claim.
Both processes have two fresh-instance warmups per case. First-process driver/font/resource effects and every warmup remain in the raw receipts and explicit outlier table.
Preparation total is request + all funded/visual pump clocks + publish. Total CPU adds the zero-step first draw; later one/eight-step draws are separate, not double-counted.
Modeled final frame is last pump + publish + first draw. Modeled peak is max(request, largest pump, modeled final frame). These sums are not measured engine frames or total arrival wall time.
Candidate publication also prunes its presenter to published entries; actual Bootstrap currently defers this cleanup. Configure and repeated production request/terrain/input/render work are excluded.
One funded entry plus its derived presentation is indivisible. No 2 ms, 16.667 ms or hardware-independent frame ceiling is established.
The reference already has T5 funded staging and T4 selection reuse. Candidate uses the same number of logical arrival pumps; this slice moves visual work into those pumps and can increase total CPU.

Exact images compare after 0, 1 and 8 adoption steps. The publication marker preserves the ordinary first-step contract, so newly staged exhibitions are at ticks 0, 0 and 7. No future-phase prewarming, extra source/payment, hidden visible plots or ordinary-walking loading gate is used.
Exact image hashes and source contracts do not establish physical input, foreground frame pacing, GPU execution/upload cost or smooth 60 FPS.
